reviews.body:
Verified head 23b4a1bd on native Windows with Node 24.11.0.

All 76 skill-use tests passed with retries disabled. Replacing only the Qoder descriptors with their parent-commit version made both new Markdown-mention cases fail because only the slash-command use was credited. Restoring the PR descriptors returned all 76 tests to passing.

I read the four-file diff and the shared prompt parsing and installation gate. The new form is enabled for Qoder and Qoder CN, requires matching link and URI names, and retains slash-command support. The existing checks still filter candidates against installed skills.

No blocking findings from this review. My verification covers the hook/unit-test path. I did not run a Qoder Desktop GUI session or independently repeat the packaged-CLI world.

Validated PR #1921 at 23b4a1bd7925fc6a456666b89650b7371f56fb10 integrated with main df433c61e937c2e1f70c722a829496c723c3c1bd: npm ci --ignore-scripts, typecheck, lint, build, focused tests (src/__tests__/skill-use.test.ts, retry 0), and built CLI --version passed. Existing representative real-CLI records and review comments checked. Approved for squash as requested by jeffyxu.
